title: Postponement of Workshop-cum-Training Programme on Pharmacovigilance for NABH Accredited Hospitals of Chennai region scheduled on 8th April 2020, at Department of Pharmacology, Govt. Stanley Medical College, Chennai
bodyHtml: Postponement of Workshop-cum-Training Programme on Pharmacovigilance for NABH Accredited Hospitals of Chennai region scheduled on 8th April 2020, at Department of Pharmacology, Govt. Stanley Medical College, Chennai has been postponed due to the Novel Coronavirus (COVID-19) outbreak till further notice.
